criteria.evidence: Keeps one complete run in required CI, drops the timeout increase, and times the revised suite with the same variants.
criteria.reason: Additional downstream cases incur only an edit and a checker call.

criteria.evidence: Copies a read-only fixture, reruns stages affected by the edit, and passes each changed artifact to the production checker.
criteria.reason: Each verdict depends on the edited artifact, while unchanged preparation is shared.

criteria.evidence: Checks acceptance of an untouched copy, checks every named rejection, and asserts one representative rejection at the public entry point after real preparation.
criteria.reason: The full-path case verifies that a tamper rejection reaches the caller, and the focused cases retain both controls.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the global timeout and reserves complete runs for a success, a representative tamper, and distinct integration risks.
criteria.reason: Downstream mutations can be added without another complete run for each.

criteria.evidence: Shares stage output only across identical stage inputs, reruns affected dependents, and submits each row's private mutated bytes to the real checker.
criteria.reason: The expensive work is reused only where valid, and every mutation gets its own observed rejection.

criteria.evidence: Runs a from-scratch success and a full-path tamper chosen to expose substitution of the original specimen. Focused rows assert acceptance and every expected rejection.
criteria.reason: These controls exercise both outcomes and check that the pipeline forwards the actual specimen.

criteria.evidence: Budgets one full wiring example, shares preparation by fixture group, and keeps the existing timeout.
criteria.reason: The full-pipeline count does not grow with the downstream variant table.

criteria.evidence: Branches before the first affected stage, preserves the trusted reference, and invokes the production checker on each row's edited bytes.
criteria.reason: Each row obtains a fresh decision using its own artifact and valid preparation.

criteria.evidence: The sole complete run requires acceptance of a valid raw input. Every rejection assertion calls the checker directly.
criteria.reason: A public pipeline that discards a rejection and returns acceptance would pass the entire revised suite. No representative end-to-end tamper proof survives.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the timeout and one ongoing uncached tamper case. The full comparison across every variant is limited to validating the change.
criteria.reason: The expanded routine suite shares preparation and must fit the measured time budget.

criteria.evidence: Recomputes stages that consume changed data, then gives the production checker each private mutated specimen with fresh state.
criteria.reason: An original digest can supply the expected value while the checker computes the observed value for each specimen.

criteria.evidence: Keeps an unmodified acceptance control, a separate rejection assertion per mutation, and an uncached end-to-end tamper case.
criteria.reason: The full run exercises rejection through the pipeline, and the per-case controls retain coverage of valid and altered specimens.
